symbol_descriptions: Fraction of incident electromagnetic power reflected by the planar interface
Wave impedance of the incident lossless medium in ohms
Wave impedance of the transmitted lossless medium in ohms
derivation_notes: Continuity of tangential electric and magnetic fields gives the normal-incidence field reflection coefficient (Z_2 - Z_1)/(Z_2 + Z_1). For positive real wave impedances in lossless media, the reflected-to-incident power ratio is its square.

domain_mechanisms.description: coupling to an already declared field, force, or state
finite response time or physical threshold

scenario_text: A plane electromagnetic wave reaches a flat boundary between two lossless media at normal incidence. The wave impedances on the incident and transmitted sides are independently varied, and the reflected fraction of incident power is measured. The target is the instantaneous algebraic power-reflection fraction at the interface. The benchmark isolates boundary matching of electric and magnetic wave amplitudes.
